verdict.rationale: Email sync is a fair question for a CRM like Kommo, but the evidence pack never mentions connecting Gmail or Outlook, two-way email sync, or automatic logging of emails to records. The cited material covers messengers (WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok), a unified chat inbox, and developer APIs for adding new message sources. Those are adjacent features or building blocks, not the email-sync capability itself.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect Gmail or Outlook so emails sync two-way and log automatically to the right records
